load_image_from_url_or_path: load an image from a URL, local file path, or base64 string and return a PIL Image
load_images_batch: load multiple images from URLs, paths, or base64 strings with support for nested list structures
load_image_as_torch_tensor: load an image from a URL, path, or base64 string directly as a torch.Tensor using torchvision
resize_image_with_mixin: resize an image using the ImageFeatureExtractionMixin resize method with size and resampling options
validate_preprocess_arguments: validate image processor preprocessing arguments like rescale, normalize, resize, and pad parameters
